name: Changelog Enforcer
description: Enforces a repository changelog to be kept up to date.

changeLogPath.description: Path to the changelog file relative to the repository

skipLabels.description:
"List of labels used to skip enforcing of the changelog during a pull request. Each label name is comma separated and only one label needs to be 
present for en

expectedLatestVersion.description: The latest version of the software expected in the changelog. Should be in the form of 'v1.1.0' etc.

versionPattern.description: "A regex pattern used to extract the version section headings from the changelog. Changelog Enforcer assumes the use of the [KeepAChangelog.com](https://keepach

missingUpdateErrorMessage.description: The error message logged and returned in the 'errorMessage' output when no update to the changelog has been found.

token.description: The secret value from your GITHUB_TOKEN or another token to access the GitHub API. Defaults to the token at `github.token`
